body.x: ARE YOU CES READY? In the world's largest technology exhibition CES 2020 that will be held from January 7 to 11, MIK (MADE IN KOREA) INNOVATION HOT SPOT zone will be held as the global project to introduce Korean startups to the world, drawing their attention.

MIK (MADE IN KOREA), which started in 2016, is an exhibition platform for K-startup centered on AVING NEWS to enter the global market with the network of global media, YouTuber, crowdfunding platforms, and investor matching program.

With various experiences and partiesconnected to the Korean Wave, it has become a place for global businessnetworking. Over the past four years, more than 700 companies have participatedin the MIK project.
Among them, MIK INNOVATION HOT SPOT will be held at EUREKA PARK, CES's start-up zone, once again this year, with the success of making hot issue last year.

Major participating organizations are Changwon Industry Promotion Agency and Gwangju University and Sungshin Women's University Startup Support Group. Ten companies n K-pop entertainment, robots, food tech, and other dynamic industries in Korea will be exhibiting here, with some of them owning the titles of being the first in the world.

First, Moderntech will be the world's first company to commercialize intelligent electric vehicle robot charging system that will lead the trend of global electric vehicle charging system. This product is an intelligent EV charging system, which is composed of an optimal system in which one robot is responsible for several charging parts.

It can solve female driver's discomfort due to the weight and safety issues that can arise from electric shock caused by heavy electric charging gun, and it can bring the maximum effect with minimum equipment by charging multiple vehicles simultaneously by changing the charging type.
Good Life is the world's first SO (Safe Outlets) that can prevent electric shock and fire even when water is poured.

It basically solves the problems such as electric shock, short circuit, and fire that exist in other outlet. It also has the function to completely cut off the electricity until the plug is completely inserted. It can be applied to all 14 outlets worldwide.

GENIESOFT will introduce Beat Smash, a VRrhythm game that uses K-pop. This product is a VR game that can be enjoyed byanyone who likes K-pop, and minimizes dizziness by providing an environmentwhere users can focus on the space.

It is being serviced in offline VR room inKorea with Smilegate, a Korean video game development company, and it will signa contract with Korean mobile service carriers KT and LG to service 3 millionmobile VR devices by 2020.
The Color Group will introduce N2FALLS, made by compressing and filling nitrogen in coffee liquid and putting it in ampules to give the rich taste of cold brew coffee in minutes.

The coffee liquid is packed in ampules with high-density SUPER DROP method to enhance portability. It is easy to expand the product lineup to juices and fruit soju. The company plans to introduce machines that incorporate portable nitro cold brew technology.
J2C will introduce its monocular irisrecognizing device by developing camera module and IR-LED, the core componentto take the picture of the the iris.

It currently holds 18 domestic and foreignpatents on iris recognition technology, and with 18 years of experience in irisrecognition technology, it is developing a wide range of iris recognitionhardware and software.

A Nine (A9) will showcase its NB-IoT solution for one-person households and lonely deaths management. When the LTE Care Plug is installed in the welfare-vulnerable household, it monitors the activities of the vulnerable household every day.

This service analyzes power consumption of home appliances and changes in illuminance of households in real time, and prevents the occurrence of lonely deaths by notifying danger in management pages and smartphones when power consumption and home lighting usage do not occur for a certain period of time.
SEESAWTALK will introduce its mobile portalon demand service platform Seesaw. Major clients are companies or communityoperators who manage multiple members (groups) by existing groupware or SNS.

With low leasing costs, customers canchoose their own functions such as closed communication, community, and variousgroup transactions such as commerce, and set up their own group service byselecting only necessary services. The service can be used immediately byinstalling the app without registration, ID and password.
MARVRUS will present its AI-based VR communication enhancement solution SPEAKIT. The solution that combines realistic content and emotional AI technology is what sets MARVRUS apart.

It provides an evaluation through an artificial intelligence dialog system based on images taken in real situations, and also provides imitation learning that can follow native expressions most quickly and effectively, and is based on technology that measures emotional data, which is a non-verbal element of users.
Deepmedi will show Neul Hyeorap and Haileythat can check health information (heart rate, stress and blood pressure, etc.)by placing your finger on the smartphone camera.

The company has a technology for estimatingheart rate signals, blood pressure, and the aging of blood vessels by measuringthe intensity of light reflected by blood as it absorbs light when shooting afinger on a mobile phone camera. The company recently developed the technologyfor estimating the heart rate from the face.

Finally, CTNS will introduce Block Battery, which can be assembled like a Lego block. Block Battery is a product that can have the battery pack be replaced and have the output added like Lego blocks, and was developed for people who need outdoor batteries and need a large capacity backup battery.

When using a small capacity battery pack, users can freely change the capacity of the battery pack by assembling additional blocks when needed, and a variety of prefabricated output layout can be used to suit the user's purpose.

MIK INNOVATION HOT SPOT PARTY will be heldduring the exhibition with the participation of media, investors, and buyers.(To participate in MIK PARTY, go to EVENT BRITE) The media and investorsvisiting MIK Zone will be served with high quality nitro cold brew coffee andtea from N2FALLS, the official partner of MIK PARTY.
Official media partners include GEEKAZINE and Ubergizmo from the US, Lecafedegeek and Monsieur GRrr from France, PRONEWS from Japan, and IT Dong-A and TechSuda and AVING NEWS from Korea.

The MIK Zone will be hosted by Next Generation Convergence Content Industry Association, MD Insight, and AVING NEWS and organized by Bluefoot. The official promotion partners of MIK Zone include air purifier humidifier MIRO, security film YES TO BE, commercial trade platform Hot Item. modist's luxury hat brand Luielle, Korean traditional hanbok brand Baek Hyunjoo Hanbok R&D Institute, and digital wireless audio company Addeleco.
